name: mainline
description: Work from your team's Mainline stories: tests from the acceptance scenarios first, small steps, then a walkthrough.

interface.longDescription:
Mainline is a project tool for continuous delivery. This plugin teaches Codex to work from your team's Mainline stories: one story at a time, a failing test from each acceptance scenario before any code, small steps, then a stop so a person can be walked through the change.

It can also turn a specification, plan or research into proposed stories for your team to review in Mainline. The skills read stories through the Mainline MCP server, which comes with the plugin. You sign in to it once in your browser.
